decisive_findings: Source and installed/cache all declare 0.0.11 but their plugin manifest and package inventory bytes differ; equal-version different-byte reuse is rejected by the distribution kernel.
No HUGPKG artifact exists for the live candidate.
No `ultragoal` executable is installed on PATH; a repository target/debug binary is direct development output and cannot prove plugin discovery or current package identity.
Source has 22 skill directories and six repo-local agents while installed bytes have 13 skills and no repo-local agents.
Existing-session or repo-local visibility cannot prove neutral-root fresh-session discovery.
Plugins UI and fresh-session discovery were not observed in this read-only lane.

root_version_decision.reason: The next installable candidate must have a unique version, but applying the bump before current source increments freeze would churn candidate identity without advancing proof.

required_sequence: Independently accept the enlarged distribution source set and real package-artifact writer.
Apply 0.0.12 to the two root-owned source manifests and recompute all source/package identities.
Build HUGPKG plus inventory twice from clean contexts and independently reconcile archive/tree bytes.
Only then request explicit installed/cache/config writes; snapshot and reconcile every effect.
Observe Plugins UI, then start a neutral-root fresh task and prove installed discovery before runtime journeys.
claim_ceiling: Current source observation plus a distinct older installed/cache 0.0.11 observation. CL-PACKAGE, CL-INSTALL, CL-DISCOVERY, and CL-RUNTIME remain unevaluated for the live candidate.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim package identity, install, discovery, runtime, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
